name: 10577 · Purchase, NY
findings: ZIP 10577 (Purchase) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10577 (Purchase) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
